messages:
sorin: Heads-up — starting provisioning for a new GPU-enabled cloud project in ap-south3. Goal: short-lived Dedicated pilot (8 A100s) + baseline infra. Need CIDR, quota request, IAM/KMS plan, and an owner for VPC peering/egress. Proposed project id: redwood-gpu-ap-south3-01. Anyone volunteer?

networking-ryan: I can own networking. Proposed VPC CIDR 10.82.0.0/16 to avoid overlap with our eu/na ranges. Prefer private subnets for node pools + NAT egress in a single AZ for now. Any hard requirements on multicast/eBPF or specialized route tables?

maya: Security constraints: GPU nodes must be in private subnets (no public IPs). Need VPC Flow Logs + audit logging enabled. We also want a dedicated KMS key per project and a small set of service accounts pre-baked.

eli: Quotas: I'll open quota requests for 8x A100 (on-demand or spot as fallback) and 4x T4 for lower-tier workloads. Cost estimate: rough $1.2k–1.6k/day depending on spot mix. Put billing tag cc:ml-infra. I'll add a budget and alert at 50%/80%/100%.

devops-jane: Sharing the minimal TF snippet we'll use for VPC so infra review is quick: 
```
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git.internal/terraform-modules/vpc.git"
  name   = "redwood-ap-south3-vpc"
  cidr   = "10.82.0.0/16"
  public_subnets  = ["10.82.0.0/18"]
  private_subnets = ["10.82.64.0/18"]
  tags = { team = "infra" env = "prod" project = "redwood-gpu-ap3" }
}
```

sorin: Nice. Hand-off checklist (my go-to):
1) CIDR confirmed and added to global overlap matrix
2) Peering requests submitted (if needed)
3) GPU quotas granted
4) VPC Flow Logs, audit logging, and DNS configured
5) KMS key + IAM roles for node pools
6) Cost center tags + budget alerts
7) Smoke-run plan for nodepool create + kernel validation

networking-ryan: I'll run the overlap checks today and open SR with provider. SR ID: SR-AP3-4321. ETA for peering/quota approvals ~48–72h (cloud-side). Also note provider's region slug changed — use `ap-south3-gpu-1` in TF vars.

maya: I'll pre-create IAM roles: compute.node, storage.objectReader, kms.decrypt. Will push the policy blob to the repo in ~45m. Also adding policy to block external IP assignment on instance templates.

eli: Quota request opened: Q-98765. Also created budget redwood-ap3: limit $20k/mo, alerts at 50/75/90%. Linked spreadsheet with cost sensitivity: https://docs.internal/costs/ap-south3-gpu (FYI this shows ~14% higher unit cost vs sfo because of egress + infra premium)

infra-oncall-bot: [deploybot] terraform plan for project redwood-gpu-ap-south3-01 completed: 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy. CI link: https://ci.internal/plan/abc123

devops-jane: After networking SR and quota approval, I'll create the initial private nodepool (2 nodes, taints tagged) on spot to validate boot and CUDA driver installation. Smoke steps: SSH to a node, run `nvidia-smi`, run a small cg test, verify KV cache connectivity to our model store.

sorin: Add a short blameless validation: run an inference perf harness with seq len 512 and compare tail p95 against sfo baseline. If >20% slower, we pause Dedicated placement.

eli: Reminder: provision with tags `team:infra`, `cost_center:ml-core`, `env:prod` so billing splits correctly. Also enable stackdriver logs export to long-term bucket with lifecycle 90d.

networking-ryan: Noted. I'll also add a secondary route table for managed NAT failover in case of AZ issues.

maya: Pushing KMS + IAM PR now. Also documenting key rotation policy — 90 days.

devops-jane: I'll open a runbook PR for the smoke-run and include commands:
`gcloud container node-pools create gpu-pool --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 --num-nodes=2 --no-address`
`kubectl apply -f gpu-driver-daemonset.yaml`
`kubectl run cuda-test --image=nvidia/cuda:11.8-base --restart=Never -- nvidia-smi`

sorin: Thanks all. Plan: wait for SR and quota, then provisioning lead (devops-jane) will execute smoke-run and report back. Check-in tomorrow 09:30 PT. Tagging @networking-ryan @maya @eli. :thumbsup:

eli: FYI spot availability in ap-south3 looks patchy — we should prepare a mixed-instance nodepool and document expected upcharge. See notes on cost sheet.

networking-ryan: SR updated with requested NAT config and peering CIDR. Keeping this thread updated as things progress.

maya: All PRs linked in runbook channel. Will follow up on KMS permissions after quota confirmation.

devops-jane: Once quotas are green I'll run the smoke-run and paste results here (short summary + `nvidia-smi` output).

sorin: Great work team — closing this thread after smoke-run and SR closures. :wave:
